findings.detail: Early-only is intentionally not adaptive deployed daily10. The plan resolves conflicting requirements via strict primary and separate prequential supplement; model-card states which one is used.
Target baseline has only 21 days point training (336 eligible lag rows) versus expanded Byron history; compare as limited-history self-training, not equal-history/full-history upper bound.

Source confidence lookup is reused for display even on target self-trained baseline; it is not a calibrated target probability. Metrics and gate use risk/width, not lookup thresholds to select samples.
Same-site/year 5-building cohort is not unseen-station/year or multi-horizon validation. High pooled retained coverage coexists with 67% rejection and poor MAE; no deployment promotion performed.
